Ta'Vaalor,.name: a smooth bone ring pierced by tiny crystal shards

raw: Across the surface of the ring, spots of ochre and brown stains radiate from tiny crystalline structures embedded in the bone.  Ichor green motes and shadows lurk within the crystals, living inclusions that alternately lighten and darken the calcification along the ring's edges.  A faint pulse, deep and bone-jarring, accompanies the flickering, beating like a necrotic heart.
The ring can be worn around the finger.  The ring appears to serve some purpose.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of bone, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a smooth bone ring pierced by tiny crystal shards indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The smooth bone ring is a prize from the Arena of the Abyss (Ebon Gate event).  When worn, it has a chance to summon an undead creature from a recently slain creature.
Attuned: No one
Charges: 0 (ON, PROD to toggle)
Lich's Curse: 0% (ON, TAP to toggle)
Voln's Blessing: 0%
Appearance: ON (COVER to toggle)

Lich's Curse is a % chance for the undead the ring spawns to be a boss creature.  Voln's Blessing is a % chance for the ring owner to receive +15 AS/DS and +10 CS/TD for 30 seconds when they kill the undead the ring spawned.
The ring cannot be altered in any way!
The smooth bone ring will cost 2,000,000 coins.

Wehnimer's Landing.name: a reinforced brass still polished to a mirror shine

raw: Much of this still is composed of a large pot-like boiler made out of brass, the wide base of the vessel resting upon a thick metal plate.  A curved spigot juts out of one side, while a large button and several knobs are scattered over its surface.  A column of intricate interconnected tubes rises from the top of the still's vat, ending in a spout.
The still can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of brass, a very common alloy.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a reinforced brass still polished to a mirror shine indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Alcohol Still --
This brass still will create alcoholic beverages, either brewed or distilled.
This is a basic still, which will require ingredients as well as charges from fire spells or golden wands to function.
In addition, you will need an alcohol recipe book to be able to select recipes to create with this still.

Food, foraged items, tea/coffee flavorings, and other items can be added to the still during the creation process to infuse extra flavoring into the finished product.  You can only add up to two (2) of these extra flavorings, but they are not required.
These extra flavorings will also affect the color of the resulting liquid.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description of this brass still are fine, but it cannot accept a show.
* The noun must remain "still" and it must be made primarily of metal.

* The article of the created alcohol can be customized, but it must be a large container that could feasibly hold alcohol.  Examples: "a bottle of", "a jug of".  This can't be longer than 15 characters.

* The created alcohol can have a long description, but there must be an open spot for the adjective, as this can differ from distillation to distillation.  Example: a bottle of (adjective) (alcohol noun) with a peeling gold label.
* The created alcohol can also have a show description as well as an inscription (READ) in any language.
* The material of the alcohol's container, as well as the top/cork, can also be customized; these are mainly used in messaging.
* Any willing merchant that is comfortable with this script can customize all of the above.
* NOTE: Altering the still itself counts as a service, while altering how the  created alcohol looks is a completely separate service.
==Features==

As a basic still, you have access to the following verbs: DROP/POUR (add ingredients/flavorings), CLEAN (empty still of in progress work), FLIP (change adjective of produced alcohol), PUSH (create alcohol).
Add golden wands to the still or cast fire spells at it to charge its power.
Adding more water to the still will weaken the resulting alcohol.
POINT an accompanying recipe book at this still to select a type of alcohol to begin making.
INSPECT the still to get an overview of how the alcohol will appear as well as where you are in the process.

WHISPER to the brass still with a potential ingredient in your hand to send it in for review.  Please be sure to include text indicating if it is not working for a specific recipe or if it's just not allowed as a flavor.
Possible alcohol effects: None.
==Current Settings==
* Alcohol 15/15/15: a bottle of,(adjective),(alcohol noun)
* Alcohol Container Material: glass [Default]
* Alcohol Container Noun: bottle [Default]
* Alcohol Container Top: cork [Default]
The brass still will cost 2,500,000 coins.

In order to scar yourself, you just need to POINT it at yourself.
Scarring Others:
To scar others, they must be following you.  Once grouped, you simply POINT the razor at them and they will need to APPROVE it.  Once approved, they will be scarred.
Razor Maintenance:
Razors need to be cleansed after they are used, and sharpened when they start to dull.  There are several different ways to clean the razor.  Some come with other effects.

Analysis of a bourde daddy longlegs spider indicates the creator has provided the following information:
An Apothecary Spider
A bourde daddy longlegs spider is a unique specimen that functions with A Spidersilk Apothecary, which can be obtained through an Ebon Gate Vault.
This particular specimen is considered an alteration spider that can only work with items crafted of cloth.
It is uniquely crafted to add a long description on qualifying items.  It can transfer one of the following designs:
1. (article) (adjective) (item noun) edged by double seams of darkened silk
2. (article) (adjective) (item noun) edged with faint ribbons of cream-colored lace
3. (article) (adjective) (item noun) edged with a narrow trim of braided silk cord
A qualifying merchant can change these designs for you.
While you can use rare materials to change the composition of your spider, you can not use it in the designs.  These spiders are not intended to override material requirements.
To utilize this unique spider, you will need to add it to a Spidersilk Apothecary.
The daddy longlegs spider will cost 300,000 coins.

~*~ Fizwixit's Wonderful Widgets ~*~

Created for August 2025's Duskruin Arena Battle Vault, the earring is a widget that will allow you to set up a temporary area for roleplaying purposes.  Enjoy a single room setup or add in a viewing room to separate your audience from your peforming area.
Whisper Setup:
* COLOR to set the color of your portals
* ROOMS to set a single-room or dual-room setup.  Single = everyone will go into the same room.  Dual = select people will go into one room and others will go into a viewing room.

* Break:  This will allow you to permanently destroy the widget in exchange for an EXP orb
* Poke:  This will allow you to permanently remove the ability to BREAK the widget
* Turn:  This opens up a portal to your roleplay area.  You get 4 uses per day for 60 minutes each, resetting at midnight Eastern time.
** You can TURN again to kick everyone out and close your portal early.  REMINDER -- this gives everything on the ground to the janitor.  Give people time to clean up.
* Hug:  You can extend the timer on your portal if you have a charge left on your widget.  This adds 60 minutes to your remaining time and uses a charge
* Point:  For setups that are restricted, POINT your earring at individuals to go into the main room
* Wave:  For dual-room setups that have both rooms with restricted entry, WAVE to set individuals who are allowed into the viewing room
* Point and Wave give them 2 minutes to get through the portal.

* You must POINT or WAVE at yourself depending on what room you wish to enter and what your restrictions are (remember, it only lasts 2 minutes, so if you want to jump back and forth, just let it wear off, apply the new one, and head into the other room!

* After you have used WHISPER to set its worn location, the earring may be freely altered

* It taks a base, long, and show (normal alteration rules, restrictions, etc. apply)

CURRENT SETTINGS:
* Theme is #1  - A stunning viridian-sanded cove
* Room setting is for a singleroom
* Restrictions are set for: no restrictions -- only valid for single room setups, anyone can enter
~*~ End Custom Analyze ~*~

This is a tier 3 Battle Standard.
Tier
1: Rally [PRAY] - While dead, allows a corpse to teleport itself back to town.  1 use per day at tier 1 and 2 uses per day at tier 3.

2: Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH] - Invoke the power of the standard's deity to create an aura that periodically lashes out at nearby creatures for 3 minutes.  Base 60 minute cooldown with 15 minutes subtracted at tiers 3, 4, and 5, resulting in a 15 minute cooldown at tier 5.
3: Reckoning - Your attacks have a chance to unleash the power of the standard's deity.  Tiers 4 and 5 increase the likelihood that this will occur.

4: Ardent Plea [RAISE] - Your attacks have a 100% chance to trigger Reckoning and unleash the power of the standard's deity.  This effect lasts 30 seconds and has a 30 minute cooldown.  At tier 5 the cooldown is reduced to 15 minutes.

5: Divine Bulwark - When you receive a blow, the standard may summon an ethereal shield to lessen the severity of the blow.  If an ethereal shield is summoned in this way, the standard's deity will unleash a retaliatory flare against the attacker.

6: Final Stand [BESEECH] - The standard's deity comes to your aid for 30 seconds, ensuring that all incoming blows will be subject to Divine Bulwark's abilities.  Can be activated while incapacitated or in roundtime.  1 use per day.
Attunement:                       Not Attuned
Charges:                          200
Deity:                            V'tull
Deity Primary Color:              Red-lined black
Deity Secondary Color:            Crimson
Rally [PRAY]:                     Ready
Hallowed Reprisal [CLENCH]:       Ready

If the standard's deity conversion ability is not on cooldown, you may visit a shrine honoring a specific deity to convert the standard to that deity.  To do so, simply PRAY standard TO <deity>.  This ability is subject to a 30 day cooldown, and the cooldown is not currently active.

This is a flag on a pole, and the description should not conflict with that.  Base, long, and show description can be altered.  Because of the holy and magical nature of this item, the description may include the following words: holy, sacred, consecrated, sacrosanct, and hallowed.

---- Animalistic Spirit Shields ----
=General Script Information=
This is a shield with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing it against like-level foes, or successfully blocking against them during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When striking, there is a chance the spirit will unleash Animalistic Fury flares.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this shield are fine.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Fury Flares (Tier 4 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out with a stampede. (Damage Type: Disruption)
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked
On a successful block, there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Fury flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Wild Backlash = Unlocked
When Animalistic Fury flares hit, the spirit within lashes out with its untamed anger, causing a momentary reduction in the target's DS and TD.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Savage Power = Unlocked (Tier 5 of 5)
Once an hour, draw on the power of the spirit within your weapon for an increase in AS, CS and critical padding by CLENCHing the buckler.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 3 of 3)

At this tier, this shield captures the following:WEAR, REMOVE, RUB (Flares On/Off), WHISTLE, TURN (targeted/untargeted), RAISE, POINT (targeted/untargeted), CLEAN, PRAY, BOW (targeted/untargeted), EXHALE, WAVE (targeted/untargeted).
* Tameness/Affinity
Tame the spirit to prevent it enacting its rage upon you.
Only one person can have allegiance to this shield's spirit at a time.
The feeling of this spirit toward someone else is cautious (Level 8 of 12).

NOTE: To switch this shield's allegiance to you, you must drop the shield's tameness to the previous owner by damaging like-level creatures with it or blocking attacks from like-level foes while in combat.

--Popcorn Kettle--
This copper popcorn kettle is an item that can create bags or buckets of edible popcorn.
This is a Basic popcorn kettle, which requires ears of corn, as well as golden wands or fire magic to work.

Food, foraged items, tea/coffee flavorings, and other items can be added to the kettle during the creation process to infuse extra flavoring into the finished product.  You can only add up to two (2) of these extra flavorings, but they are not required.
These extra flavorings will also affect the color of the resulting kernels.
You can also optionally add melted butter and/or salt.
Paper bags made with the Paper Maker can be added to the copper popcorn kettle to be used in the next batch of popcorn.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description are fine, though this kettle cannot take a show.
* The noun must remain "kettle" with the word popcorn preceding it in the adjective field.
* The kettle must be made primarily of metal.

* Custom Container alterations can be done by any willing merchant.  Bag containers must be a paper/parchment material and have an appropriate noun for a bag.  Bucket containers must be wood or metal and have an appropriate noun for an open-topped solid container.

NOTE: You need to provide a max 15-character article (IE 'a bag of'), a material/noun that gets used in the popcorn's messaging (IE 'paper bag'), the part of the description leading up to the noun (IE 'a bag of <adjective> <noun>'), and and words after the noun (IE 'crafted from red and white striped paper').
==Features==

As a Basic popcorn kettle, you have access to the following verbs: DROP/PUT (add ingredients), FLIP (change adjective of created popcorn), CLEAN (reset settings), PINCH (change between bag or bucket container), PUSH (create popcorn), ROLL (change cooking level), NUDGE (change popcorn effect), TWIST (change popcorn after-noun description), SLAP (toggle between popcorn or container description), WAVE (change container design), GAZE (view current custom container designs).
INSPECTing the kettle will provide you a wealth of information on the current state the popcorn is in.
WHISPERing to the kettle with an item in your other hand can send a copy of that item to the proper authorities if the kettle isn't properly accepting something as an ingredient.
The copper popcorn kettle will cost 100,000 coins.

--------- VIEW FROM A STAG SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This kaajkur is a View From a Stag saddle meant for use with "cervid" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this kaajkur:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target cervid} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  RIGHT; LEFT; POMMEL; MANE; JUMP; GRACE-L; GRACE-R
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this kaajkur's current setup are:  POMMEL; MANE, JUMP, SLIDE, GRACE-L, GRACE-R

The kaajkur can have various accessories added to it, if they were made specifically for a kaajkur:  a saddle pad, a saddle blanket, and either bells or trim.  If you have an accessory, you will need to hold both items and SLAP the saddle to add it; to remove an accessory, PRY for bells/trim, and PINCH or PINCH KAAJKUR WITH {PAD|BLANKET} for pad/blanket.  Some accessories change the long description.  This kaajkur currently has the following accessories attached:
*bell item (platinum bells)
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the kaajkur.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description being present because accessories can temporarily change the long description.
Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to kaajkur (Finnian).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  Its pommel is low-rise (doesn't really jut up vertically), and the cantle is what you'd expect from a "normal" saddle. Icemule Trace.name: a burnished copper popcorn kettle polished to a mirror sheen

raw: Essentially a large pot with slightly slanted sides, the copper popcorn kettle looks well-made and extremely complex.  Several compartments encircle it on every side to hold various ingredients, while a cast iron plate runs along its base.  The top of the kettle has a loosely fitting lid with a curved spout running over one side where the freshly popped kernels are likely meant to drop out of the mechanism.
The kettle can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of copper, an extremely common metal.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a burnished copper popcorn kettle polished to a mirror sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--Popcorn Kettle--
This copper popcorn kettle is an item that can create bags or buckets of edible popcorn.
This is a Basic popcorn kettle, which requires ears of corn, as well as golden wands or fire magic to work.

Food, foraged items, tea/coffee flavorings, and other items can be added to the kettle during the creation process to infuse extra flavoring into the finished product.  You can only add up to two (2) of these extra flavorings, but they are not required.
These extra flavorings will also affect the color of the resulting kernels.
You can also optionally add melted butter and/or salt.
Paper bags made with the Paper Maker can be added to the copper popcorn kettle to be used in the next batch of popcorn.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description are fine, though this kettle cannot take a show.
* The noun must remain "kettle" with the word popcorn preceding it in the adjective field.
* The kettle must be made primarily of metal.

* Custom Container alterations can be done by any willing merchant.  Bag containers must be a paper/parchment material and have an appropriate noun for a bag.  Bucket containers must be wood or metal and have an appropriate noun for an open-topped solid container.

NOTE: You need to provide a max 15-character article (IE 'a bag of'), a material/noun that gets used in the popcorn's messaging (IE 'paper bag'), the part of the description leading up to the noun (IE 'a bag of <adjective> <noun>'), and and words after the noun (IE 'crafted from red and white striped paper').
==Features==

As a Basic popcorn kettle, you have access to the following verbs: DROP/PUT (add ingredients), FLIP (change adjective of created popcorn), CLEAN (reset settings), PINCH (change between bag or bucket container), PUSH (create popcorn), ROLL (change cooking level), NUDGE (change popcorn effect), TWIST (change popcorn after-noun description), SLAP (toggle between popcorn or container description), WAVE (change container design), GAZE (view current custom container designs).
INSPECTing the kettle will provide you a wealth of information on the current state the popcorn is in.
WHISPERing to the kettle with an item in your other hand can send a copy of that item to the proper authorities if the kettle isn't properly accepting something as an ingredient.
The copper popcorn kettle will cost 100,000 coins.

Icemule Trace.name: a burnished copper popcorn kettle polished to a mirror sheen

raw: Essentially a large pot with slightly slanted sides, the copper popcorn kettle looks well-made and extremely complex.  Several compartments encircle it on every side to hold various ingredients, while a cast iron plate runs along its base.  The top of the kettle has a loosely fitting lid with a curved spout running over one side where the freshly popped kernels are likely meant to drop out of the mechanism.
The kettle can not be worn.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of copper, an extremely common metal.  This material cannot be dyed.
Analysis of a burnished copper popcorn kettle polished to a mirror sheen indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--Popcorn Kettle--
This copper popcorn kettle is an item that can create bags or buckets of edible popcorn.
This is a Basic popcorn kettle, which requires ears of corn, as well as golden wands or fire magic to work.

Food, foraged items, tea/coffee flavorings, and other items can be added to the kettle during the creation process to infuse extra flavoring into the finished product.  You can only add up to two (2) of these extra flavorings, but they are not required.
These extra flavorings will also affect the color of the resulting kernels.
You can also optionally add melted butter and/or salt.
Paper bags made with the Paper Maker can be added to the copper popcorn kettle to be used in the next batch of popcorn.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description are fine, though this kettle cannot take a show.
* The noun must remain "kettle" with the word popcorn preceding it in the adjective field.
* The kettle must be made primarily of metal.

* Custom Container alterations can be done by any willing merchant.  Bag containers must be a paper/parchment material and have an appropriate noun for a bag.  Bucket containers must be wood or metal and have an appropriate noun for an open-topped solid container.

NOTE: You need to provide a max 15-character article (IE 'a bag of'), a material/noun that gets used in the popcorn's messaging (IE 'paper bag'), the part of the description leading up to the noun (IE 'a bag of <adjective> <noun>'), and and words after the noun (IE 'crafted from red and white striped paper').
==Features==

As a Basic popcorn kettle, you have access to the following verbs: DROP/PUT (add ingredients), FLIP (change adjective of created popcorn), CLEAN (reset settings), PINCH (change between bag or bucket container), PUSH (create popcorn), ROLL (change cooking level), NUDGE (change popcorn effect), TWIST (change popcorn after-noun description), SLAP (toggle between popcorn or container description), WAVE (change container design), GAZE (view current custom container designs).
INSPECTing the kettle will provide you a wealth of information on the current state the popcorn is in.
WHISPERing to the kettle with an item in your other hand can send a copy of that item to the proper authorities if the kettle isn't properly accepting something as an ingredient.
The copper popcorn kettle will cost 100,000 coins.

Teras Isle.name: an autumnal-hued leaf-bladed vultite dagger with a honey opal hilt

raw: The craftsmanship of this dagger is exquisite, evident in the forging of the blade's delicate curves and the artistry of its design.  Dyes that shift from goldenrod to rust and rust to carmine bathe the blade, blending from light to dark from edge to midline, where etching traces the fall of an aspen leaf.  One edge of the leaf furls nearest the guard, which is bowed upward as if to catch it.  Honey opal forms the hilt beneath a cross-thatching of leather, teasing glimpses of the ginger-flared gem.
There appears to be something written on it.
Between the etched wisps on the blade tracking the leaf's fall are the words, "Autumn's Glow."
The dagger is a dagger that requires skill in edged weapons to use effectively.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of vultite, an uncommon metal.
Analysis of an autumnal-hued leaf-bladed vultite dagger with a honey opal hilt indicates the creator has provided the following information:

The script on this dagger is for zesty weapons and was originally released by Siolan during Ebon Gate 5105.  All alterations (longs and shows) are acceptable for this item within normal alteration guidelines.  It is currently Tier 3 of 3 possible tiers.  Current verbs are: FLIP, PINCH (at), PROD, PULL, PUSH, RUB, SCRATCH, TURN, TOUCH, and WAVE.
You can tell that the dagger is as light as it can get.
The vultite dagger will cost 10,000,000 coins.

Made of suede layered over a framework of steel, this taxidermy kit is a boxy contraption consisting of interior compartments.  Several flaps and panels, each one closed with round bone toggles, cover the sides and top of the kit, while recessed latches are hidden beneath folds of suede.
The kit can be worn, attaching it to the belt.
It looks like this item has been mainly crafted out of leather, an extremely common material.
Analysis of a supple suede taxidermy kit indicates the creator has provided the following information:
--Taxidermy Kit--
==General Information==
This taxidermy kit is a special object that stores remnants from huntable creatures.  These remains can be made into taxidermy specimens and other items.
It requires acid or blood magic to be able to preserve creature parts; it can gain charges from crystal, bloodwood wands, as well as spells of the appropriate type.
Some creations made with this kit require stuffing, as well, which can be made by DROPping in foraged cotton bolls or scrap pieces of fabric.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the taxidermy kit's 15/15/15 and long description are fine, though it must remain a "taxidermy kit".  It also cannot take a show.
* The kit is supposed to have an interior made of metal and an exterior made of fabric or leather/suede.
* The material of the interior, the material of the exterior, and the adjective/material for the toggles can be customized by any willing merchant.
==Features==
* Creature Remnant Slots [5 out of 25 Unlocked]
While having a dagger in one hand, DROP a dead creature into your taxidermy kit to store its remains.  This requires there to be enough acid/blood magic to preserve the remnants.
You can GAZE at the kit to see a list of your remnant slots, and TURN the kit to switch to a different remnant slot.
* Taxidermy Specimens [Unlocked]
These are taxidermied versions of the creature remnant stored.  It requires stuffing to create these unless it is a skeleton or skull.
They can be PLACEd on the ground as a prop or displayed in a private property.
Sub-Types Unlocked: Full Body, Head.
* Stuffed Puppy Toys [Locked]
Creates a stuffed version of a puppy toy out of the creature remains.  This requires a charge of stuffing to create.
Sub-Types Unlocked: Creature Remnant Noun.
* Sock Puppet [Locked]
Creates an OTS version of a Sock Puppet using the creature remnants.  The puppet itself is considered to be made of leather, with the skin of the chosen remnant being used to make the puppet's hair.
Sub-Types Unlocked: Creature Remnant Noun.
* Rugs [Locked]
Creates a rug made out of the skin of the chosen creature remnant.  These rugs can be PLACEd in the room or at-feet; additionally, you can SIT on them.
Sub-Types Unlocked: <creature remnant noun> <fur/skin/feather> rug, <creature remnant noun> <skin/hide> rug, <pattern> <color> rug.
* Articles [Locked]
If unlocked, you can change the article of your potential creation with PEDAL.
* Post-Noun (Long) Descriptions [Locked]
If unlocked, you can change the post-noun (long) description of your creations with TWIST.  You can also toggle the post-noun description showing up at all with COVER.
* Adornments [Pelts=Locked, Decoration=Locked, Eyes=Locked]
If unlocked, you can add gems/metal/wood/glass to use for eyes, pelts/hides for trim, and antlers/horns/teeth/bones for extra decoration.
These additions will open more options for articles and post-noun descriptions, if available.
* Dye [Locked]
If unlocked, you can POUR cobbling or alchemy dye into the taxidermy kit and dye your creations.
Your taxidermy kit has access to the following commands:
DROP/PUT (add remnants/supplies), TURN (change remnant slot), CLEAN (empties currently selected option), FLIP (change creation sub-type if available), PUSH (create object with current settings).
Additionally you can use INSPECT on the kit to get a wealth of information on how your next creation will appear, as well as GAZE to view the status of all the kit's creature remnant slots.
==Current Settings==
* Exterior Material: suede
* Interior Material: steel
* Toggle Adjective/Material: round bone
The taxidermy kit will cost 10,000,000 coins.

This is a chrismarium, a holy relic that stores the oil and balsam from inside a chrism gem, allowing you to stockpile multiple charges inside for later application to a corpse.  While anyone may add chrism oil to it, it may only be used by clerics to apply the chrism effect.
It may be altered but must remain made of metal, and the noun must remain chrismarium.
This chrismarium is at tier 2 out of 5.  A skilled merchant might be able to unlock it further.
It will hold a maximum of 40 charges.
It is currently using the "Standard" messaging style.

You can PUSH the chrismarium with a chrism in your other hand to store it within.  This destroys the chrism and adds one charge to the chrismarium.  The charges within the chrismarium are as effective as the average of all chrism gems absorbed in this fashion.
You can PROD the chrismarium to stop being warned about when chrism's quality would reduce the average of the chrismarium's contents.
These warnings only apply to the 'fullness' of chrisms and none of their other qualities.

You can POUR the chrismarium on a player to grant them its effects, provided you are skilled in using chrisms.  You can also POUR it on the ground, which wastes a charge but may be useful if you want to replace the contents with higher-quality chrisms.
Unlocked verbs: PUSH, POUR, LOOK, MEASURE, RUB, PROD, PONDER

Analysis of a cherrywood keepsake container indicates the creator has provided the following information:
OVERVIEW

Hello there, intrepid adventurer!  This keepsake container is a Market Stall item.  These items allow you to set up temporary stalls to display and sell items in rooms that are in towns but not noded.  While out, you may set up items for sale that other players may purchase.  Proceeds from the sales subject to a 5% tax and are stored in the stall until you retrieve them.
USE

This item may be PLACE'd to set up a temporary market stall or to collapse one back down into something a bit more portable.  Stalls will remain standing for up to 4 hours before collapsing and being sent to the Adventurer's Guild Recovery system.  To interact with the stall, simply ASK STALL FOR HELP to get a listing of commands.  Some commands are restricted to the owner.

Tier 1-4 Stalls may be PLACE'd 1x per day while Tier 5 stalls may be PLACE'd or REFRESH'd 2x per day.  A player may only have one stall per room and private properties are restricted to one owner placed (indefinitely lasting) stall per property.
ALTERING
This item may be freely altered with both longs and shows.  The only restriction is on the nouns when deployed and collapsed.  Approved nouns are:
Deployed Nouns: stand, table, counter, booth, kiosk, stall, crate
Collapsed Nouns: case, tray, chest, box, container
Note: Only one noun may be in use in any given room.
The item's sign may also be altered by any willing merchant but altering the shopkeeper is a rare service that is restricted to Naidem merchants only.
SETTINGS
This container is Tier 4 of 5.
Collapsed Base Description: a cherrywood keepsake container
Collapsed Long Description:
Collapsed Show Description:
Stall Base Description: a cherrywood market stall
Stall Long Description: a cherrywood market stall topped in a checkered awning
Stall Show Description:
Shopkeeper: a craggy peddler.  It has a sleazy personality.
Silver capacity:  It has had its capacity expanded 1 times.  It can currently hold 1,400,000 silvers.
Shopkeeper announcement unlock: locked.
Display sign: a small wooden stand
This keepsake container will stay put for 4 hours and may be PLACE'd or REFRESH'd 1 time per day.
STAY PUT

This item has Stay-Put qualities.  If you PLACE it, it will be moved to the ground in your current room and stay there, unable to be picked up by others or taken by the janitor, for 4 hours.  You may NUDGE it at a valid container to place the container on top of the container until you NUDGE it out of its place again.  After the duration expires, the item is fair game for others and for the janitor.  Alternately, the item may be PLACEd by the owner of a private property within the grounds of the property or by the owner of a stall or loft in and will stay there until PLACEd or NUDGEd again.
The keepsake container may be lightened 1 pound at a time down to a minimum of 5 pounds.
The keepsake container will cost 15,000,000 coins.

Analysis of a large wicker basket indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the Basketifier, straight out of the shop Preserving Breads at Evermore Hollow!
This basket is designed to hold food items for you.  It will keep them fresh and unlimited until you decide to remove them.
It is currently tier 4 of 4, which means it will house 24 food items.
To use the basket, simply follow these steps:
1. PUT - use this to add food items to the basket.
2. RUB - use this to prepare a food item for removal.
3. TURN - Use this to remove a food item from the basket.  (must be charged with a small statue)
To create a picnic, follow these steps:
1. PULL - to pull the blanket out.  This will move all food to the blanket, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. PUSH - to clean up the picnic.  This will move all food and the blanket back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The picnic will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
To create a table, follow these steps:
1. PROD - to set the table out.  This will move all food items onto the table, and the basket will be turned into a trashcan.
2. TINKER - to clean up the table.  This will move all food back into the basket and return the basket to its natural state.
The table will stick around for two hour(s) before folding up.  This can be renewed using HUG.
A large wicker basket has 1 charges stored in it that can be used to remove food.
Alterations:
The basket may be altered freely, but it must remain a basket.  It can have a long or show description.
Basket's Blanket: a fringed red and black cloth
It must maintain a noun of blanket, cloth, tablecloth, or something similar.  It may have a long or a show description and must be made of fabric.
Table Base: a rough oak table
The table must keep the noun table.  It may have a long or a show description and needs to be made of wood.
Customizing food in the basket is a special, delayed service.
The wicker basket will cost 4,000,000 coins.
